march/motion#webgl.name: webgl

march/store#persist.doc: Save a store node to localStorage (debounced) and load it back now. Errors (private mode, quota) are ignored.
march/store#persist.signature: function persist<T extends object>(node: T, key: string, __2: { storage?: Storage; delay?: number } = {}): () => void
march/store#persist.tr: Bir depo düğümünü localStorage'a kaydeder (geciktirmeli) ve hemen geri yükler. Hatalar (gizli mod, kota) yok sayılır.

march/store#readonly.name: readonly
march/store#readonly.doc: Read-only view: reads stay reactive; writes throw.
march/store#readonly.signature: function readonly<T extends object>(node: T): Readonly<T>
march/store#readonly.tr: Salt okunur görünüm: okumalar tepkisel kalır; yazmalar hata fırlatır.

march/store#snapshot.name: snapshot
march/store#snapshot.doc: Deeply frozen plain copy of a store node (safe to keep, compare or serialize).
march/store#snapshot.tr: Bir depo düğümünün derinlemesine dondurulmuş düz kopyası (saklamak, karşılaştırmak veya serileştirmek için güvenli).

march/store#storeLog.name: storeLog
march/store#storeLog.doc: Development change log of a store (last 1000 changes; empty in production).
march/store#storeLog.tr: Deponun geliştirme değişiklik günlüğü (son 1000 değişiklik; üretimde boş).

march/store#subscribe.name: subscribe
march/store#subscribe.doc: Listen to every change at or below `node` (a store or any nested object/array of it). Returns unsubscribe.
march/store#subscribe.signature: function subscribe(node: object, fn: Listener): () => void
march/store#subscribe.tr: `node` ve altındaki (depo veya içindeki herhangi bir iç içe nesne/dizi) her değişikliği dinler. Abonelikten çıkma işlevini döndürür.

march/props#mProps.name: mProps
march/props#mProps.doc: Apply common props by hand (the compiler writes this call for `m:` attributes): `mProps(h(Card, props), { "no-select": true })`. `target` is what h() returned: an element, a component's output (its root elements get the props; a live region is followed as it changes) or a list of these. A value may be a function (live). Returns the target to render.
march/props#mProps.signature: function mProps<T>(target: T, props: Record<string, unknown>): T
march/props#mProps.tr: Ortak (`m:`) prop'ları elle uygular: `mProps(h(Card, props), { "no-select": true })`. Öğeye ya da bileşenin kök öğelerine yazar; değer fonksiyon olabilir (canlı).

march/props#registerMProp.name: registerMProp
march/props#registerMProp.doc: Add a common prop: `registerMProp("tone", (el, v) => …)` makes `m:tone` work on every element and component. Register before the first render that uses it. A built-in member of the extension pipeline (extend()): the compiler applies `m:` props itself, so it only runs for `h(Comp, { "m:tone": … })` written by hand.
march/props#registerMProp.signature: function registerMProp(name: string, apply: MProp): void
march/props#registerMProp.tr: Yeni bir ortak prop ekler: `registerMProp("tone", (el, v) => …)` ile `m:tone` her öğede ve bileşende çalışır.

march/props#withParts.name: withParts
march/props#withParts.doc: Give props to the components drawn inside `render`, whatever draws them: `m:parts` on any element or component. `<PostCard post={post} m:parts={{ Avatar: { size: "lg" }, LikeButton: { color: "brand-blue" } }} />` compiles to `withParts(new Map([[Avatar, {…}], [LikeButton, {…}]]), () => h(PostCard, {…}))`; write that call by hand in plain JS. Every component of that kind created inside the scope (now or later: a list row, a branch that opens) gets the props; they win over what its parent gave it, the nearest scope wins over an outer one. `parts` may be an accessor: the props that were set when a part was created stay live. A component called as a plain function (not through h() / JSX) is not reached.
march/props#withParts.signature: function withParts<T>(parts: PartsMap | (() => PartsMap | null | undefined), render: () => T): T
march/props#withParts.tr: `m:parts` ortak prop'unun elle yazımı: içeride çizilen bileşenlere türüne göre özellik verir (ebeveynin verdiğini ezer, en yakın kapsam kazanır): `withParts(new Map([[Avatar, { size: "lg" }]]), () => h(PostCard, props))`.

march/app-ui#addMissing.name: addMissing
march/app-ui#addMissing.doc: Adds the panels the layout lacks, each at its `place` (else the right edge).
march/app-ui#addMissing.signature: function addMissing(layout: DockTree, defs: readonly PanelDef[]): DockTree
march/app-ui#addMissing.tr: Düzende olmayan panelleri kendi yerlerine (`place`) ekler.

march/app-ui#allot.name: allot
march/app-ui#allot.doc: Splits `avail` px by weights keeping minimums; when they do not fit, the minimums shrink in proportion. Integers.
march/app-ui#allot.signature: function allot(avail: number, weights: number[], mins: number[]): number[]
march/app-ui#allot.tr: Pikseli ağırlıklara böler, en küçük boyutları korur; sığmazsa orantılı küçültür.

march/app-ui#allPanels.name: allPanels
march/app-ui#allPanels.doc: Every panel id in the tree.

march/app-ui#canCollapse.name: canCollapse
march/app-ui#canCollapse.doc: False for the last open group.
march/app-ui#canCollapse.signature: function canCollapse(layout: DockTree, groupId: string): boolean
march/app-ui#canCollapse.tr: Grup daraltılabilir mi (son açık grup daraltılamaz).

march/app-ui#collapseGroup.name: collapseGroup
march/app-ui#collapseGroup.doc: Collapses a group to a strip; with `geo` its pixel size is kept and given back on restore.
march/app-ui#collapseGroup.signature: function collapseGroup(layout: DockTree, groupId: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#collapseGroup.tr: Grubu şeride daraltır; boyutu saklanır, açılınca geri döner.

march/app-ui#collapseMode.name: collapseMode
march/app-ui#collapseMode.doc: The strip direction a group WOULD get if collapsed: "horizontal" (title level) or "vertical" (title at -90°).
march/app-ui#collapseMode.tr: Grup daraltılırsa şeridin yönü: yatay ya da dikey (başlık -90 derece).

march/app-ui#computeRects.name: computeRects
march/app-ui#computeRects.doc: The layout in pixels: open groups, strips, splitters between open neighbours, and each split's sizes.
march/app-ui#computeRects.signature: function computeRects(layout: DockTree, area: Rect, opts: RectOptions = {}): Rects
march/app-ui#computeRects.tr: Düzenin pikselleri: açık gruplar, şeritler, ayırıcılar ve her ayrımın boyutları.

march/app-ui#equalize.name: equalize
march/app-ui#equalize.doc: Double click: the open children of a split become equal (collapsed ones keep their stored share).
march/app-ui#equalize.signature: function equalize(layout: DockTree, splitId: string): DockTree
march/app-ui#equalize.tr: Ayrımdaki açık çocukları eşit boyuta getirir.

march/app-ui#findNode.name: findNode
march/app-ui#findNode.signature: function findNode(L: DockTree, id: string): LayoutNode | null

march/app-ui#focusOnly.name: focusOnly
march/app-ui#focusOnly.doc: Focus mode: the panel's group stays open, every other group goes to a strip (the caller keeps the old layout).
march/app-ui#focusOnly.signature: function focusOnly(layout: DockTree, panel: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#focusOnly.tr: Odak kipi: panelin grubu açık kalır, öbür gruplar şeride iner.

march/app-ui#fromTree.name: fromTree
march/app-ui#fromTree.doc: A layout from a tree written without ids.

march/app-ui#groupOf.name: groupOf
march/app-ui#groupOf.signature: function groupOf(L: DockTree, panel: string): TabsNode | null

march/app-ui#groups.name: groups
march/app-ui#groups.doc: Every tab group, in tree order.

march/app-ui#hitTest.name: hitTest
march/app-ui#hitTest.doc: The drop target under the pointer while dragging, or null. The outer edge docks to the whole workspace.
march/app-ui#hitTest.signature: function hitTest(rects: Rects, x: number, y: number, opts: Partial<Metrics> = {}): Hit | null
march/app-ui#hitTest.tr: Sürüklerken imlecin altındaki bırakma hedefi: dış kenar, sekme başlığı ya da grubun beş bölgesi.

march/app-ui#isCollapsed.name: isCollapsed
march/app-ui#isCollapsed.doc: Collapsed: a group by its flag, a split when every child is.
march/app-ui#isCollapsed.tr: Düğüm kapalı mı: grup kendi bayrağıyla, ayrım bütün çocukları kapalıysa.

march/app-ui#LAYOUT_V.name: LAYOUT_V
march/app-ui#LAYOUT_V.doc: Version of the saved layout format (a saved layout of another version is ignored).
march/app-ui#LAYOUT_V.tr: Kayıtlı düzen biçiminin sürümü; başka sürümdeki kayıt yok sayılır.

march/app-ui#maximize.name: maximize
march/app-ui#maximize.doc: Toggles a group filling the whole area.
march/app-ui#maximize.signature: function maximize(layout: DockTree, groupId: string): DockTree
march/app-ui#maximize.tr: Grubun tüm alanı kaplamasını açar ya da kapatır.

march/app-ui#METRICS.name: METRICS
march/app-ui#METRICS.doc: Pixel metrics: gap between areas, collapsed strip, group header, outer-edge hit band, outer inset.
march/app-ui#METRICS.value: Object.freeze({ gap: 6, strip: 28, header: 33, edge: 6, inset: 8 })
march/app-ui#METRICS.tr: Piksel ölçüleri: boşluk, şerit, başlık, dış kenar payı.

march/app-ui#movePanel.name: movePanel
march/app-ui#movePanel.doc: Moves a panel. target: a group id or ROOT; zone: a side or center; index: tab position (center).
march/app-ui#movePanel.signature: function movePanel(layout: DockTree, panel: string, target: string, zone: Zone, index?: number): DockTree
march/app-ui#movePanel.tr: Paneli taşır: bir grubun kenarına (yeni bölme), ortasına (sekme) ya da alanın kenarına.

march/app-ui#moveTab.name: moveTab
march/app-ui#moveTab.doc: Tab order: the panel moves to `index` in its group.
march/app-ui#moveTab.signature: function moveTab(layout: DockTree, panel: string, index: number): DockTree

march/app-ui#normalize.name: normalize
march/app-ui#normalize.doc: Drops empty groups and one-child splits, flattens nested splits of the same direction, weights sum to 1.
march/app-ui#normalize.tr: Boş grupları ve tek çocuklu ayrımları atar, aynı yöndeki iç içe ayrımları düzler.

march/app-ui#presetLayout.name: presetLayout
march/app-ui#presetLayout.doc: A layout from a preset tree, fitted to the panels at hand.
march/app-ui#presetLayout.signature: const presetLayout: (preset: Preset | undefined, defs: readonly PanelDef[]) => DockTree | null
march/app-ui#presetLayout.valueType: (preset: Preset | undefined, defs: readonly PanelDef[]) => DockTree | null
march/app-ui#presetLayout.tr: Hazır düzenden eldeki panellere uygun bir düzen kurar.

march/app-ui#resetPanel.name: resetPanel
march/app-ui#resetPanel.doc: A panel goes back to its default place (its own `place`).
march/app-ui#resetPanel.signature: function resetPanel(layout: DockTree, def: PanelDef, defs: readonly PanelDef[]): DockTree

march/app-ui#resizeSplit.name: resizeSplit
march/app-ui#resizeSplit.doc: Splitter: moves `delta` px between children a and b, minimums kept; the other neighbours do not move.
march/app-ui#resizeSplit.signature: function resizeSplit(layout: DockTree, splitId: string, a: number, b: number, delta: number, rects: Rects): DockTree
march/app-ui#resizeSplit.tr: Ayırıcı: iki komşu arasında piksel taşır, en küçük boyutları korur.

march/app-ui#restoreGroup.name: restoreGroup
march/app-ui#restoreGroup.doc: Opens a strip: the group gets its share (or its pixel size) back; `panel` comes to the front.
march/app-ui#restoreGroup.signature: function restoreGroup(layout: DockTree, groupId: string, panel?: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#restoreGroup.tr: Şeritteki grubu açar; eski payına ya da saklanan boyutuna döner.

march/app-ui#restoreLayout.name: restoreLayout
march/app-ui#restoreLayout.doc: Reads a saved layout: null when broken or of another version; unknown and repeated panels drop, missing ones are added.
march/app-ui#restoreLayout.signature: function restoreLayout(raw: unknown, defs: readonly PanelDef[]): DockTree | null
march/app-ui#restoreLayout.tr: Kayıtlı düzeni okur: bozuksa boş döner, bilinmeyen paneller düşer, eksikler eklenir.

march/app-ui#reveal.name: reveal
march/app-ui#reveal.doc: Makes a panel visible: opens its strip, brings its tab to the front, ends another group's maximize.
march/app-ui#reveal.signature: function reveal(layout: DockTree, panel: string, geo?: Geo): DockTree
march/app-ui#reveal.tr: Paneli görünür yapar: şeridini açar, sekmesini öne alır.

march/app-ui#ROOT.name: ROOT
march/app-ui#ROOT.doc: The whole workspace as a drop target (docking to the outer edge).
march/app-ui#ROOT.tr: Bırakma hedefi olarak alanın tamamı (dış kenara yanaştırma).

march/app-ui#serialize.name: serialize
march/app-ui#serialize.tr: Düzeni düz JSON olarak verir (kaydetmek için).

march/app-ui#setActive.name: setActive
march/app-ui#setActive.doc: Brings a panel's tab to the front of its group.
march/app-ui#setActive.signature: function setActive(layout: DockTree, panel: string): DockTree

march/app-ui#singleLayout.name: singleLayout
march/app-ui#singleLayout.doc: Every panel in one tab group (the fallback with no preset).
march/app-ui#singleLayout.signature: const singleLayout: (defs: readonly PanelDef[], active?: string | null) => DockTree
march/app-ui#singleLayout.valueType: (defs: readonly PanelDef[], active?: string | null) => DockTree
march/app-ui#singleLayout.tr: Bütün panelleri tek sekme grubunda toplayan düzen.
